Synopsis:
    Russian children's hospice founder Lida Moniava was detained and charged with spreading false information about Russian military actions against Ukrainian civilians. A Moscow court imposed pre-trial restrictions through October 30, including a daytime home curfew and social media ban. The case is part of a broader Kremlin crackdown on anti-war dissent, with over 1,380 prosecutions since the full-scale invasion began.
